_comment: Public copy for cycle 2 boards: the words a reader on the Sense repository sees.
Kept as data, not prose in the renderer, so a wording change is a one-line edit
and never a code change. Blurbs are short and name the thing plainly, because
these pages are read online and a reader arrives knowing the repo or the model,
